title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Secures a $300 Million Unsecured Term Loan
summary: Wells Fargo and Seven Other Lenders Participated in Credit Facility InvenTrust Properties Corp. (InvenTrust or the Company) announced today it has entered into a new $300 million unsecured term loan credit facility (the Facility) with a group of lenders led by Wells Fargo Securities, LLC (Wells Fargo). The Facility is available for general corporate purposes including acquisitions and maturing debt payoffs. This borrowing capacity significantly increases InvenTrusts financial resources for both working capital and the Companys future debt maturities. "The execution of this new credit facility provides an opportunity to enhance InvenTrusts strong capital position and balance sheet capacity, said Michael E.
